title: Cross-chain message, claim and finality handling
confirm: How is the source chain and sender authenticated on the receiving side; who can submit a message?
Is a message id consumed exactly once, and does the id include chain ids on both ends?
What finality does the relayer assume, and what happens on reorg or a failed execution (refund path, retry path)?
Fee and native-value handling on the claim path: who ends up holding dust or overpayment?
